---
title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Extract county precinct files to a temporary directory and read them all in
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())
raw_results <- read_tsv(files, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE, quote = "")

# Filter to the Republican primary for Governor and sum votes by candidate
gov_rep <- raw_results |>
  filter(X12 == "Governor", X16 == "REP") |>
  summarize(votes = sum(as.numeric(X19), na.rm = TRUE), .by = X15) |>
  rename(candidate = X15)
```

```{r}
gov_rep |>
  mutate(candidate = fct_reorder(candidate, votes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = votes, y = candidate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official statewide vote totals by candidate",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
